summary: Implements item 3 of issue 972 only: configured_test_roots wraps the unchanged resolver and warns once per project root naming traceability.test_roots; the cross-layer gate replaces the add-a-test advice with a no-tagged-test-scanned note when the head manifest links no test; resolution still returns []; _cross_layer_result keeps its default so other callers are unchanged; the note never raises.
